title: Isolate authority PersistFences from bulk persist work and move WAL checkpointing off the commit path (termal.sqlite 4.6 GB, WAL never truncated)
outcome: A decided persistence design: an authority PersistFence is no longer queued behind a full metadata and transcript tick, and WAL checkpointing no longer runs synchronously inside the persist thread's COMMIT. It is backed by recorded per-phase timing (w-0e3b338ac4a4's F1), and approved by Greg if it changes durability.
acceptance: A design note, with file:line, for: (1) priority or metadata-only commit for pending authority fences; (2) WAL management, i.e. wal_autocheckpoint and journal_size_limit, and a separate checkpoint cadence, given termal.sqlite at about 4.6 GB and a never-truncated 125 MB WAL. It covers durability and crash-safety consequences, and is grounded in timing recorded by w-0e3b338ac4a4's F1, not in synthetic load.
Greg's or the coordinator's recorded decision on the design, and a follow-up implementation item if one is chosen.
